description: DiScharge of condition 32 pursuant to planning permission reference 161144FUL dated 14/02/2017 for 'Demolition of all existing buildings and the redevelopment of the site to provide a double storey basement with four buildings of 2, 9, 11, 32 and 42 storeys comprising 578 residential flats (Use class C3)(mix of 1 bed, 2 bed and 3 bed flats) and 3179sqm (GIA) of flexible use class A1 and/or A2 and/or A3 and/or A4 and/or B1 and/or D1 and/or D2 floorspace, landscaped east-to-west public route between Victoria Road and Portal Way, together with associated amenity and play space, roof gardens, cycle parking, car parking, servicing, public realm improvements, landscaping and infrastructure works. (Full Planning Application accompanied by an Environmental Impact Assessment)'
